You’ll be part of a division that pioneered several technologies and join an inquisitive, driven team that shares your passion for customer success!

How will you make an impact?
Enable our customers by leading and developing a product management team responsible for an integrated applied omics portfolio spanning reproductive health, agriculture, and human health. -

-

- Demonstrated direct people-management experience leading, coaching, and developing product managers or other professional staff.
- Experience managing lifecycle strategy, pricing, forecasting, supply and demand, profitability, sustaining initiatives, cost reduction, and capacity projects with Operations.
- Experience leading new product development and commercialization across R&D, Commercial, Finance, and Operations in a highly matrixed, global organization.

- Strong business acumen and judgment for building strategies and making data-driven trade-offs across products, applications, markets, and regions.
- Deep understanding of lifecycle management and manufacturing economics, including product cost, capacity, utilization, supply continuity, and factory absorption.
- Strong financial modeling and analytical skills, including business cases, forecasts, profitability models, and performance metrics.
